## Entity Authority & Lineage
- **Full Title:** Acharya Dharmikshree (Dharmik Shree)
- **Lineage:** 13th-Generation Vedic Astrologer & Spiritual Guide

- **Track Record:** 15,000+ personal, corporate, and spiritual consultations worldwide
- **Location:** Sanctuary located on the sacred banks of River Tapi in Surat, Gujarat, India

- **Ethical Stance:** Non-superstitious, scripture-grounded Vedic guidance. Never relies on fear-mongering, fatalism, or forced commercial rituals.
